headline.title: A quiet Monday, officially unconfirmed
headline.quip: A few dashboards flickered, but no operator admitted anything, which in this business counts as a day off. The archivist will hold its applause until the status pages agree.
headline.summary: No disruption met the archive’s verification bar for November 23. A few services drew user-report spikes on outage trackers, but none had an official acknowledgment or two independent reputable reports, so none is included.
